subject: SIG/CAIQ: personnel audit excerpts and onboarding/offboarding transaction log
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa@securebank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: sample artifacts for SIG/CAIQ personnel controls

Hi Soojin,

As part of SecureBank's vendor review for SIG/CAIQ, our security team needs a small set of sample artifacts demonstrating Redwood's onboarding/offboarding and background check processes. Specifically:

- A short excerpt of the onboarding transaction log showing account creation, role assignment, and initial training enrollment (CSV or similar)
- Redacted background check samples for 2–3 recent hires (clearly PII-redacted)
- A short offboarding checkpoint summary showing access revocation timeline for a terminated employee

We only need sample artifacts (not full datasets) and prefer them redacted for privacy. Could you confirm you can provide these by EOD 20-Jan? If there are any constraints (e.g., longer lead time with the vendor), please call that out.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Park
Security Compliance Manager, SecureBank
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@securebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for SIG/CAIQ personnel controls

Hi Lisa,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide those samples. Quick notes on scoping and timing: 

- Onboarding transaction log excerpt: we will export a 2-week slice and redact user IDs to non-PII tokens. Format: CSV with columns (timestamp, action, actor_role, resource, comment).
- Background check samples: the vendor provides redacted PDF reports; we'll request 3 samples (we typically keep vendor originals internally and produce redacted copies for audits). Expect a short turnaround from BackgroundCheckPro (they usually provide redacted copies within 24–48 hours).
- Offboarding checkpoint summary: HR will produce a one-page PDF with timeline checkpoints (disable SSO, deprovision GCP, revoke GitHub) for a terminated case.

I'll coordinate with Neha to pull the artifacts and with Laura to confirm redaction policy. If that works, we'll target delivery by 2026-01-20 COB PST.

Would you prefer delivery via a shared drive folder (we'll add view-only permissions) or direct upload to your vendor portal?

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: BackgroundCheckPro <evidence@bgcheckpro.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for SIG/CAIQ personnel controls

Soojin / Laura,

Attached are the prepared artifacts for initial review prior to sending to SecureBank: 

1) onboarding_transaction_log_excerpt.csv (6 rows) — columns: timestamp, action, actor_role, resource, comment. IDs replaced with tokens (user_###).
2) background_check_redacted_samples.zip (3 PDFs) — vendor-supplied redacted reports (we confirmed removal of SSN, DOB, residential addresses). Inside zip: redacted_report_2023-08.pdf, redacted_report_2024-03.pdf, redacted_report_2025-11.pdf.
3) offboarding_checkpoint_summary.pdf — HR one-pager for case #RB-2024-057 showing action timestamps and responsible teams.

Notes on redaction & provenance:
- BackgroundCheckPro performed vendor-side redaction; we also ran a secondary redaction script to strip remaining email addresses from notes.
- The onboarding log is an extract from our internal audit table (personnel_audit_events) and includes only system-level events — no free-text employee notes are included.

Please review and flag any items that need further redaction before we share externally. Once approved, I will upload to the SecureBank shared folder and notify Lisa. BackgroundCheckPro: if you can confirm the redacted PDFs are cleared for external sharing, please reply-all.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
HR Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachment: onboarding_transaction_log_excerpt.csv - CSV)
(attachment: background_check_redacted_samples.zip - ZIP)
(attachment: offboarding_checkpoint_summary.pdf - PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-01-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for SIG/CAIQ personnel controls

Hi all,

Thanks Neha — reviewed the artifacts. Redaction looks good to me (verified SSN/DOB/address stripped, user IDs tokenized). BackgroundCheckPro confirmed the PDFs have vendor-side redaction and permission to share under our standard non-PII audit disclosure.

I've uploaded the three artifacts to the shared SecureBank folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-personnel-audit-excerpts (view-only link). Delivery notes attached in the folder: delivery_manifest.txt and a short README describing redaction steps and provenance.

Lisa — we delivered the requested samples. Let us know if you want a short phone walkthrough of the artifacts; happy to jump on a 20-minute call.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops, Redwood Inference
